title: Gemma 4 call record
description: One line of logs/dayN.jsonl. Every call to the model through wrapper.py produces exactly one record matching this schema. Each record is a research observation; reproducibility depends on metadata completeness.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, UTC, when the request was issued.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent in the request.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling top_p sent in the request.

seed.description: RNG seed sent in the request; null when no seed was set.

prompt_messages.description: Full chat message array exactly as sent.

completion.description: Full text of the model's completion.

host_metadata.description: Per-backend host metadata. Heterogeneous across backends (vllm-gemma exposes cuda_driver + vllm_image_tag; ollama-coder exposes ollama_base_url; anthropic exposes prompt_cache). Existing fields remain optional for back-compat with pre-multi-backend records.

backend.description: Backend discriminator, e.g. 'ollama', 'anthropic'. Absent on legacy vllm-gemma records.

cuda_driver.description: CUDA driver version on the serving host (vllm-gemma). Optional.

caller_tag.description: Identifies what issued the call, e.g. 'test_50_calls'.

parent_request_id.description: request_id of the parent call in a chain; null until call chains begin on Day 4.

run_id.description: Run-mode identifier (experiment trial-loop, autoresearch sweep, or LOOP_V0 iteration) this call was issued under. OPTIONAL — set by wrapper.set_run_id; absent on calls made outside a run-mode context and on all pre-2026-06-06 records.

backend.description: Backend registry name that served this call (e.g. 'vllm-gemma', 'vllm-qwen', 'ollama-coder', 'anthropic'). OPTIONAL — absent on all pre-2026-06-10 records. Distinct from host_metadata.backend (a heterogeneous discriminator): this is the top-level blessed UI-attribution field.

max_tokens.description: Generation cap (max_tokens) the caller requested for this call. OPTIONAL — a request param, not a logged-by-default field; absent when the caller passed no cap and on all pre-2026-06-06 records.

retrieval_context.description: Per-call retrieval provenance (P2). null when no retrieval ran. A list when one or more retrievals contributed to the prompt — typically generator and novelty-evaluation calls. Optional field; absent on records that pre-date Day 3.5.

content_hash.description: Hash of the chunk content used in the prompt, e.g. 'sha256:...'.

chunk_offset.description: Byte or token offset of the chunk within the source document.

chunk_length.description: Byte or token length of the chunk.
